evidence.quote: July 27 (Reuters) - Nvidia is in talks to provide roughly $250 billion in financing guarantees for OpenAI as part of a massive data center project, the Wall Street Journal reported ‌on Sunday.
evidence.one_line: Reuters 于 2026 年 7 月 27 日报道，援引《华尔街日报》称，Nvidia 正与 OpenAI 洽谈为数据中心项目提供约 2500 亿美元融资担保。
evidence.speaker: Reuters

evidence.quote: The $250 billion guarantee covers the data center lease ⁠and debt financing, but would not cover the Nvidia chips inside the center, the WSJ said, adding that the chipmaker was also discussing financing OpenAI's chip purchases worth up to $350 billion.
evidence.one_line: 《华尔街日报》称，约 2500 亿美元担保涉及数据中心租赁和债务融资、不包括中心内的 Nvidia 芯片；Nvidia 还在讨论为 OpenAI 提供最高 3500 亿美元的芯片采购融资。
evidence.speaker: Reuters 转述《华尔街日报》
